start.topic: Perimeter of rectangles, squares and polygons
start.opening: Namaste Kabir, main Asha, aapki AI teacher. Aaj perimeter padhenge. Aapko shapes mein sabse zyada kya pasand hai—square, rectangle, ya polygon?

turns.line: board par ek dinosaur ka skeleton banao
turns.reply: Kabir, skeleton: lambi haddiyan, reedh ki haddi, chaar pair aur poonch—yeh purane dinosaurs ke fossils mein milta hai. Ab perimeter ke liye sab sides jodiye.

turns.line: board par rocket engine ka diagram banao
turns.reply: Rocket engine mota cylinder jaisa hota hai, neeche bell-shaped nozzle aur andar fuel chamber hota hai. Bana diagram. Is shape ka perimeter kin sides se milega?
